correction: The bottom time anchor uses NIST CODATA Planck time in seconds; the Planck length is recorded separately in meters.

precedent.v77Interpretation: 1.6161e-35 seconds treated as user-defined bottom symbolic time anchor

coordinates.zComposite: conceptual state-time pairing, not numeric addition

constants.note: Decimal values are rounded and l_P=c*t_P should agree within rounding of the reported coefficients; both have nonzero uncertainties originating in G.

model.equalityOperator: cross-scale symbolic correspondence, not literal equality of measured durations
model.sharedAxisRule: same x/y/z coordinate grammar for all three scale labels
model.earlierClockStatus: archival and independent; not CODATA Planck time

boundaries: NIST values are recommended physical constants, not an experimentally verified minimum duration or minimum distance.
T, M, B are symbolic scale views; assigning Planck units to B does not imply atomic diameters or times equal Planck dimensions.
Star/planet/atom scale correspondence is not a derivation of physical time dilation.
The user's spelling 'plank' is retained as a label, distinct from the scientific name 'Planck'.
Old v7.7 and v7.4 data are preserved in their original files.
